title: phaseolus vulgaris var. niger
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. niger, commonly known as Black Jack bean or Black turtle bean, is a variety of the common bean plant. This plant is known for its high nutritional value and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and lowering blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Phaseolus vulgaris var. niger include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hypoglycemic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to scavenge free radicals, inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes, and stimulate the secretion of insulin, making it a valuable medicinal plant.
